summary_evidence_spans: In this context, the aim of this study is to develop a valid and reliable scale to obtain accurate data on artificial intelligence literacy by examining the concept of artificial intelligence literacy.
The study sample consists of 870 students (424 boys, 346 girls) in grades 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 attending elementary and middle schools.
A pool of 50 items was created to measure students’ levels of artificial intelligence literacy.
Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) resulted in 22 items and 6 subscales.
The measurement model obtained from Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) demonstrated good fit.

original_excerpt: This study investigates primary school students' motivational typologies and the factors related to these configurations in AI‐supported extracurricular French vocabulary learning. … Twenty learners completed a Q sorting task based on 34 motivational statements, and eight participants were subsequently selected for semi‐structured interviews. … Q factor analysis identified four motivational typologies: socially supported learners, future‐oriented learners, enjoyment‐driven learners and mastery‐oriented learners.

summary_evidence_spans: This study investigates primary school students' motivational typologies and the factors related to these configurations in AI‐supported extracurricular French vocabulary learning.
Twenty learners completed a Q sorting task based on 34 motivational statements, and eight participants were subsequently selected for semi‐structured interviews.
Q factor analysis identified four motivational typologies: socially supported learners, future‐oriented learners, enjoyment‐driven learners and mastery‐oriented learners.

original_excerpt: This paper presents a game-based human-AI collaboration probe designed to examine how children verify AI suggestions during task-based interaction. … The system embeds AI suggestions within a biological knowledge reasoning game and compares three Agent interaction styles: partner-like, tool-like, and dual-state Agent. … A preliminary evaluation with children aged 8-10 combined interaction logs, post-task ratings, and semi-structured interviews.

summary_evidence_spans: This paper presents a game-based human-AI collaboration probe designed to examine how children verify AI suggestions during task-based interaction.

A preliminary evaluation with children aged 8-10 combined interaction logs, post-task ratings, and semi-structured interviews.
